overall: The AG found the Airport Master Plan Planning Advisory Committee was not a public body because it never acted collectively, so it could not violate the Open Meeting Law; no violation and no orders.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Planning Advisory Committee formed by the Airport Commission to update the Airport Master Plan violated the Open Meeting Law.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, based on the specific facts of this case, we find that the Planning Committee was not a body empowered to act collectively.
